I'm interested in using the Distance analysis-engine as a stand-alone =
program. I've read how to do so in the Distance help section. I was =
wondering if anyone has written an application which acts as a "loop" to =
run several surveys through the analysis-engine and then combine the =
individual outputs into one output. =20
I would appreciate replies on this particular request and advice from =
those who have used the analysis-engine as a stand-alone program for =
other reasons. Please reply to: jk...@u.washington.edu
I would be glad to compile the responses and send them back to the =
group.
Thank you,
John
